name: ATech Gold Spacer Truck
description: This simple but sturdy long-range freighter is said to be the most common starship operating between different settlements of the Pact Worlds. AbadarCorp often decorates its blocky base in gold, but most Gold Spacer Trucks are purchased without the iconic color, and customizing your own truck is a time-honored tradition among long-haul transporters across the Pact Worlds.

specialAbilities.name: Cargo Ejection
specialAbilities.effect: The cargo bay of an ATech Gold Spacer Truck instantly detaches and moves 1 zone away in the event the starship is destroyed, often ejecting at the same time and in the same direction as the starship’s escape pods.

name: Inheritorworks Surestrike
description: Much like the Lance-Marines deployed by Cathedralships, Surestrike drones are autonomous vessels used to multiply the Knights’ effectiveness in combat despite their small pool of valorous pilots. While they pose little threat on their own, they’re equipped with high-power comms arrays that can generate interference in enemy ships, allowing a single manned vessel to easily defeat an opponent while offering a chance for repentance.

specialAbilities.name: Autonomous Starship
specialAbilities.effect: The starship isn’t helmed by living creatures. Autonomous starships have the tech trait and are immune to mental damage and effects.

specialAbilities.name: Buzzing Storm
specialAbilities.requirements: Two or more other Surestrikes are within 0 zones
specialAbilities.effect: The Surestrike links with other Surestrike units, unleashing a storm of electrical interference. A starship within 0 zones must attempt a DC 16 Will save. That starship then becomes immune to Buzzing Storm for 10 minutes.

outcomes.success: Any of the target’s battle stations that are unhelmed become malfunctioning for 1 round.
outcomes.failure: All of the target’s battle stations that are unhelmed become malfunctioning. Each creature helming one of the target’s battle stations must succeed at a DC 16 Will save or their battle station becomes malfunctioning.
outcomes.criticalFailure: As failure, but creatures helming the target’s battle stations take a –2 circumstance penalty to their saves.

name: Raider Trident
description: There are few starships that are as cost-effective to produce and acquire as the Trident. Free Captains receive access to its schematics so they can fabricate them on their own starships. However, this deadly vehicle has proven to be as dangerous for its driver as it is for its targets. As it chews through its prey’s hull, the Trident is an easy and brittle target that often gets caught in the crossfire.

specialAbilities.name: Chainsaw Prow
specialAbilities.effect: The Free Captain starship sinks its rotating blades into the hull of a starship within 0 zones. The target takes 1d4+3 slashing damage with a basic Fortitude save against DC 13. If Chainsaw Prow deals damage to the target’s Hull Points, and the target is larger than the Free Captain starship, the Free Captain starship clings to the target. Until the start of the Free Captain starship’s next turn, it moves with the target whenever the target moves.

name: Dutybound Necrofighter
description: The Dutybound Necrofighter is a mass of unalive bone and chitinous flesh created in Barrow’s flesh foundries. It spends its brief unlife following commands sent to it by its fleet.

specialAbilities.name: Grave Interception
specialAbilities.trigger: A starship within 0 zones would take damage from a Strike
specialAbilities.effect: The Dutybound Necrofighter rushes forth to intercept the attack. It reduces the triggering damage by its remaining Hull Points and takes damage equal to the amount it reduced. If it’s destroyed by this damage, the starship it protected takes the remaining damage.

name: Ringworks Sentinel
description: This mid-range transport starship uses a combination of solar sails and rotating thrusters to expertly navigate the debris fields of the Diaspora, with the armaments necessary to protect itself from asteroids and space pirates. The starship is capable of doubling as an aquatic vehicle.

specialAbilities.name: Starskim
specialAbilities.effect: The Sentinel uses its shields as sails. Increase its Speed to 5 zones, and it gains a +2 circumstance bonus to AC, but reduces its SP to 0. This effect ends when the Sentinel uses Fortify Shield Points.

name: BD Freighter
description: One of the most ubiquitous starship models across Near Space, manufactured by the notorious EJ Corp (pronounced “Edge”), the BD Freighter is a small, mass-produced cargo hauler. Following a recent economic setback, EJ Corp has largely abandoned its practice of leasing these ships in favor of selling them off in large quantities for short-term profit. It’s common to see BD Freighters sporting a variety of logos, alternative paint jobs, and equipment customizations.

specialAbilities.name: TARN
specialAbilities.effect: EJ Corp’s proprietary Technical Automated Resource Network (TARN) is an AI model that assists in piloting the BD Freighter, allowing even rookie pilots to maneuver around obstacles with ease. The BD Freighter ignores up to 1 zone of Speed penalty.

specialAbilities.name: Run Blockade
specialAbilities.effect: The BD Freighter diverts power to its generator and Boosts Thrusters while performing evasive maneuvers. This movement doesn’t trigger reactions, and the BD Freighter gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and Reflex saves until the start of its next turn.

name: Bastion Driller
description: Bastion Drillers are rarely seen on their own; they have a limited effective range, and their ability to latch on to enemy starships and damage them over time is most effective when supported by other ships distracting their target. However, these autonomous drones are cheap to produce and effective in groups, so they’re often fielded as a force multiplier for a larger fleet of Ambassadors or Scouts.

specialAbilities.name: Autonomous Starship
specialAbilities.effect: The starship isn’t helmed by living creatures. Autonomous starships have the tech trait and are immune to mental damage and effects.

specialAbilities.name: Latch Claw
specialAbilities.requirements: The Driller’s last action was a successful sting Strike
specialAbilities.effect: The Driller latches onto the required Strike’s target. Whenever the target moves, the Driller moves with it, and the Driller gains a +2 circumstance bonus to its AC. Both effects last until the Driller Strikes a different target or leaves the target’s zone, or until the target succeeds at a DC 17 Piloting check as a single action, whichever happens first.

specialAbilities.name: Stinging Drill
specialAbilities.requirements: The Driller is latched onto a starship with Latch Claw
specialAbilities.effect: The target takes 1d6 piercing damage. This damage ignores SP and damages HP.

name: Infernex Burning Nail
description: Infernex Burning Nails are the most numerous starships manufactured by Infernex’s hell-forges. Like most starships their size, they’re doomed to be deployed as cannon fodder in battles with larger cohorts, but a truly devious “hammer” (the nickname for a Burning Nail’s pilot) can take out a target twice its size.

specialAbilities.name: Kindling of Order
specialAbilities.effect: The Burning Nail’s hull ignites into infernal flames. Each non-allied starship within 0 zones takes 2d6 fire damage (DC 14 basic Reflex save). The Burning Nail regains Hull Points equal to half the damage dice it rolls. The Burning Nail can’t use Kindling of Order for 1d4 rounds.

name: Long-Haul Freighter
description: Long-Haul Freighters are a common sight throughout the Vast, shipping trade goods from one distant world to another. While most militaries have the good sense not to disrupt shipping lanes, pirates are common enough that Freighters are usually equipped with simple weapons systems and defensive maneuvers, allowing them to escape danger when needed.

specialAbilities.name: Drop Cargo
specialAbilities.effect: The Long-Haul Freighter releases some of its cargo, creating a crate cluster in its current zone. Moving into a crate cluster costs an extra 1 zone of movement, and starships have concealment while within the cluster against attacks from starships outside the affected zone.

specialAbilities.name: Hard Burn
specialAbilities.effect: The Long-Haul Freighter Boosts Thrusters three times. It can’t Change Heading until the start of its next turn.

name: Sovereign Harrier
description: This streamlined fighter makes up a large portion of the Azlanti Star Empire’s star fleet due to how cheap it is to manufacture and how simple it is to pilot. These lightning-fast starships are assigned to cadets and treated as disposable strike forces to overwhelm enemy fleets at the start of space battles.

specialAbilities.name: Space Sovereignty
specialAbilities.effect: The Sovereign Harrier Boosts Thrusters twice, and if it moves at least 5 zones, it makes a Strike at a target in the direction of its current heading. On a critical hit, the target takes a –1-zone status penalty to Speed and a –1 status penalty to AC and Reflex saves for 1 minute.

specialAbilities.name: Speed Sigil
specialAbilities.effect: The starship empowers its engines by activating a seven-pointed sigil. The starship gains a +2-zone status bonus to its Speed and a +1 status bonus to its AC and Reflex saves for 1 minute.

name: UC Pod
description: Pods are the most common vessels seen orbiting Xenowarden Arkships’ orbital nurseries. Pods are typically deployed in pairs or small flights as scouting parties, for allies allow Pods to make the most of their capabilities.

specialAbilities.name: Primal Comms
specialAbilities.effect: The UC Pod’s crew can communicate with starships in sensor range using a primal comms relay incorporated into its magic conduit. Attempting to Hack Comms against a UC Pod requires a Nature check instead of a Computers check.

specialAbilities.name: Living Starship
specialAbilities.effect: The starship is a living organism or composed entirely of biomass. A living starship usually has organs or structures instead of battle stations. Living starships don’t have starship immunities.

specialAbilities.name: Primal Bond
specialAbilities.trigger: The UC Pod takes damage and has 13 or fewer HP
specialAbilities.effect: The UC Pod gains fast healing 3, which ends when it has 14 or more Hit Points.

specialAbilities.name: Spore Cloud
specialAbilities.effect: The UC Pod Boosts Thrusters, creating a spore cloud in each zone it leaves during this movement. The spore cloud lasts until the start of its next turn. Starships outside the spore cloud are concealed to starships inside it.

name: Yolaku Canopyskipper
description: Named after one of the two moons of Pulonis, the Yolaku Canopyskipper was one of the few native starships made on Pulonis during its war for independence that was not design by the Veskarium. Capable of hovering inside even the atmospheres of high-gravity worlds, the Canopyskipper is primarily a troop transport that can drop or recover forces using climbing cables featuring powerful electromagnets to haul away goods or even unconscious targets. The starship features a machine gun to help clear a space before it deploys its passengers.

specialAbilities.name: Dropship Cables
specialAbilities.effect: The Canopyskipper can deploy or retrieve up to eight cables at once up to 300 feet downward, each of which can be held onto or Climbed with a successful DC 10 Athletics check. At the ends of each of these cables is a magnet capable of lifting up to 6 Bulk and are intended to affix to armor. They require a creature adjacent to the magnet to use an Interact action to attach the cable. Multiple cables can be used to lift larger loads, with each additional cable increasing the amount of Bulk that can be lifted by 6.

name: Hivebound Clustership
description: These writhing components appear to be little more than mandibles and claws, though a close inspection reveals they’re composed of dozens of smaller components that gnash and buzz against each other. The hideous sound of a Clustership biting into the hull of your starship is always followed by the terror of the Swarm bursting through the passageways.

specialAbilities.name: Living Starship
specialAbilities.effect: The starship is a living organism or composed entirely of biomass. A living starship usually has organs or structures instead of battle stations. Living starships don’t have starship immunities.

specialAbilities.name: Engaged Strike
specialAbilities.effect: This starship attempts a cluster maw Strike against the triggering starship.
specialAbilities.trigger: A starship in the same zone moves to another zone

specialAbilities.name: Distributed Hive Mind
specialAbilities.effect: The Clustership treats all starships in its zone or in the same zone as another Clustership as off-guard.

name: Kevolari Wanderlust
description: An evolution of the popular Kevolari Venture, this ship was designed to keep its crews safe while exploring dangerous territories. Drones were added to help distract enemies while the ship fortifies its shields, attempting to scare enemies away with the prospect of a desperate battle of attrition.

specialAbilities.name: Deploy Remote Turret
specialAbilities.effect: The Kevolari Wanderlust deploys a remote turret in its current zone. The turret is a tiny starship object with AC 18, 8 HP, Hardness 4, and object immunities. The Kevolari Wanderlust can have only two deployed remote turrets at a given time. If it would deploy a third, one of its previously deployed remote turret is destroyed.

specialAbilities.name: Orbital Bombardment
specialAbilities.effect: Each remote turret of the Kevolari Wanderlust’s choice within sensor range targets a starship in its zone and fires a barrage of lasers. Multiple turrets can’t target the same starship. The targets take 2d6 fire damage with a DC 18 basic Reflex save.

specialAbilities.name: Shield Scramble
specialAbilities.requirements: At least two remote turrets are currently deployed
specialAbilities.effect: The satellites target a starship within the Wanderlust’s sensor range with a deluge of electromagnetic waves to disrupt the target’s shields. The target must succeed at a DC 18 Fortitude save or else its generator can’t use Fortify Shield Points until a creature helming the station uses an Interact action to restore shield generation capabilities with a successful DC 18 Crafting check (on a critical success, the target becomes immune to Shield Scramble for 24 hours).

name: Raider Rustbringer
description: The Rustbringer is an old model renowned for its ability to impair other starships. Its design is based on an old mining starship that was built for scorching hot environments. It uses a highly pressurized liquid that can instantly cool down and solidify molten metal to then mine it safely using its drill. The engineers on Broken Rock Oath have adapted the mining vessel to become a cornerstone of the tactics of many a Free Captain pirate crew.

specialAbilities.name: Cryo Corrosion
specialAbilities.effect: When the Raider Rustbringer deals damage to a starship’s Hull Points with its zero hydro hose, the spray damages the target’s systems. The affected starship must attempt a DC 17 Fortitude save; on a failure, one battle stations of the Rustbringer’s choice becomes malfunctioning. If the battle station is helmed, the creature helming it takes 2d6 cold damage (DC 17 basic Fortitude save).

name: Sword-Class Attack Vessel
description: These vessels embody the Gideron Authority’s military strategy, which focuses on two things above all else: strength in numbers, strength in the offensive. The Gideron Authority mass-produces these small attack ships in favor of larger battleships. They can strike out of nowhere using their Helldrives, and the Gideron Authority is willing to sacrifice as many Attack Vessels as necessary in such surprise attacks to ensure victory against stronger starships.

specialAbilities.name: Engaged Strike
specialAbilities.effect: This starship attempts a coilgun Strike against the triggering starship.
specialAbilities.trigger: A starship in the same zone moves to another zone

specialAbilities.name: Ambush from Hell
specialAbilities.effect: The Sword-Class Attack Vessel efficiently stores and recycles the ambient magical energy in Hell while traveling with its Helldrive. Surrounded by Hellish imagery and fire, it rushes forward and assails a foe. It Boosts Thrusters and makes a Strike against a starship. The Strike deals an additional 1 fire damage per weapon damage die, and if it hits, the Sword-Class Attack Vessel attempts an Intimidation check to Demoralize the target. The Sword-Class Attack Vessel can’t use Ambush from Hell until it travels to Hell again.

name: BMC Mauler
description: The classic BMC Mauler is popular in the Veskarium military for its incredible versatility. The agile starship can fight in atmosphere just as well as it can in vacuum, using its incredible lateral mobility to outmaneuver foes who underestimate its capabilities. BMC Maulers remain the vessel of choice for honor duels between vesk fighter pilots.

specialAbilities.name: Engage Lateral Thrusters
specialAbilities.effect: The Mauler moves up to its Speed in any direction.

specialAbilities.name: Merciless Aim
specialAbilities.effect: The BMC Mauler locks onto a starship in sensor range. While locked-on, the target takes a –1 status penalty to its AC and Reflex saves against the BMC Mauler until the end of the BMC Mauler’s next turn or until it’s targeted by an attack from one of the BMC Mauler’s gunneries, whichever happens first.

name: Barrow Dirgesinger
description: Among an array of disturbing starships, the Barrow Dirgesinger stands out as a uniquely distasteful invention of the Corpse Fleet. Named for the hideous sound of gnashing machinery and tortured screams as the vessel’s flesh-mills churn, a Dirgesinger often heralds the arrival of a fearsome force.

specialAbilities.name: Clinging Flesh
specialAbilities.trigger: The Barrow Dirgesinger Area Fires with its fragment launcher
specialAbilities.effect: The launched fragments of flesh cling to the hull of their targets. Each starship that took damage to its Hull Points from the triggering Area Fire becomes infested with undead. Once per round, when an infested starship moves at least 1 zone, it can attempt a DC 17 Piloting check, shaking off the infestation of undead on a success.

specialAbilities.name: Gnashing Fragments
specialAbilities.effect: The Barrow Dirgesinger sends out a pulse to starships infested by Clinging Flesh within sensor range. An affected starship takes 4d6 bludgeoning damage to its Hull Points, bypassing its Shield Points, with a DC 17 basic Fortitude save.

specialAbilities.name: Horrifying Clanging
specialAbilities.requirements: The Barrow Dirgesinger’s last action on this turn was Gnashing Fragments, and the starship targeted by it is still infested with undead
specialAbilities.effect: The Barrow Dirgesinger attempts to Demoralize each enemy creature on the required starship.

name: Dominion Derelict
description: Any long-haul space traveler worth their salt has heard a horror story or two about the so-called “ship stealers,” the alloid agents of the Dominion of the Black. These malleable creatures creep into the hull of small ships and slay the crew, taking over the ship and returning it to their masters’ foundries. Such stolen ships can often be found drifting in space, waiting for kindhearted passersby to search for survivors—only to find themselves added to the alloids’ haul and their starship turned into new bait to lure in more unwary travelers.

specialAbilities.name: Ambush!
specialAbilities.trigger: An enemy moves within 1 zone of the Dominion Derelict
specialAbilities.requirements: The Dominion Derelict is under the effect of Lie in Wait
specialAbilities.effect: The Dominion Derelict springs to life, then makes a light laser cannon Strike against the triggering enemy. The target is off-guard to this Strike.

specialAbilities.name: Malleable Dodge
specialAbilities.trigger: An enemy targets the Dominion Derelict with a Strike
specialAbilities.effect: The Dominion Derelict’s hull twists disturbingly, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to its AC against the triggering Strike.

specialAbilities.name: Lie in Wait
specialAbilities.effect: The Dominion Derelict can spend 10 minutes to disguise itself and mask its presence, appearing to be an ordinary wreck until it takes any other action. A starship that’s Seeking Starships can attempt a Perception check against the Dominion Derelict’s Stealth DC to detect its true nature.

name: Dread Buccaneer
description: The Buccaneer is a simple yet deadly starship, favored by many newly formed pirate crews. It can easily disable its enemies’ battle stations with its harpoon, leaving other starships helpless in the face of its pulsecaster cannon. These simple starships are synonymous with the Free Captains in the eyes of civilians, thanks largely to their ominous silhouette appearing in a number of popular pirate vids. Dread Buccaneers often fall upon their targets accompanied by boarding pods carrying pirates ready to jump aboard their target starship and start looting it from the inside.

specialAbilities.name: Piercing Harpoon
specialAbilities.effect: The Free Captain starship launches a harpoon at another starship within 1 zone. The target starship takes 2d8 piercing damage and attempts a Fortitude save against DC 19.

outcomes.failure: The target takes full damage, and the Free Captain starship chooses a battle station on the target starship to become malfunctioning.
outcomes.criticalFailure: The target takes double damage, and the Free Captain starship chooses a battle station on the target to become malfunctioning. Additionally, the harpoon causes a Hull Breach hazard (page 251) to appear in a space adjacent to the malfunctioning battle station.

specialAbilities.name: Wave Holo-Roger
specialAbilities.effect: A Free Captain starship’s holo-roger is a sight that gives rise to courage in the hearts of its allies. Allied creatures and starships within sensor range of the starship gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Will saves against fear effects for 1 round.

name: Flint-Class Mining Vessel
description: Doubling as geological research stations, Flint-Class Mining Vessels travel Near Space in search of critical resources for the Marixah Republic. It can use its mining lasers as weapons in an emergency or briefly redirect its hardlight hauling net to impede foes.

attacks.name: hardlight net
attacks.damage: 1d6+7 bludgeoning ; on a failure, targets take a –2-zone status penalty to Speed for 1 round (2 rounds on a critical failure)

specialAbilities.name: Starmetal Sensors
specialAbilities.effect: The Flint-Class Mining Vessel uses this sensor array to detect metals and minerals, but it also passively scans starship hulls within sensor range and automatically discerns their immunities, weaknesses, and resistances.

name: Inheritorworks Brightsword
description: Brightswords are perhaps the most iconic part of a fleet of Knights, for these two-seater fighters battle with massive hardlight greatswords extending from their nose. The sight of their glowing golden blades flashing past your porthole is the surest sign that the Knights are here to help.

specialAbilities.name: Flying Blade
specialAbilities.effect: The Brightsword either Changes Heading and Boosts Thrusters, or Boosts Thrusters twice. At any point during this movement, it can make a hardlight blade Strike.

name: Jinsul Breacher
description: Between their slim numbers and analytical mindsets, jinsuls have developed countless tricks to enhance the efficiency of their starships. The Jinsul Breacher can operate at full efficiency with a crew of only four; deployment ducts that run through the vessel allow the jinsuls within to rapidly redeploy to different weapon stations or to the breaching ram, from which they can directly board an opposing starship.

specialAbilities.name: Deploy Breachers
specialAbilities.trigger: The Jinsul Breacher deals damage to a starship’s Hull Points with its breaching ram
specialAbilities.effect: When the Jinsul Breacher deals damage to a starship’s Hull Points with its breaching ram, it creates a boarding pod (page 250) in a space on the target starship with a jinsul trooper (Starfinder Alien Core 98) on board.

specialAbilities.name: Rapid Redeployment
specialAbilities.effect: The Jinsul Breacher transfers crew through its delivery ducts. Until the end of the Jinsul Breacher’s turn, it gains a +2 circumstance bonus to attacks with its light laser cannon or its breaching ram and a –2 circumstance penalty to attacks with the other.

name: SC Jackknife
description: The latest Szandite Collective starship model is an evolution of its small, long-range research vessels: With the heavy scanners, shielding, and housing areas stripped down, the ships make for excellent long-range scouts. Jackknife starships emphasize speed and utility but can make quick work of enemies in their iconic “fan of knives” formation, which has spread to military training academies across Near Space.

specialAbilities.name: Szandite Crystal Comms
specialAbilities.effect: The SC Jackknife can communicate with other Szandite Collective starships or settlements at any distance using its onboard szandite crystals, which allow for instant mental communication to other szandite crystals.

specialAbilities.name: Fan of Knives
specialAbilities.effect: While it’s within 0 zones of another SC Jackknife, the SC Jackknife’s Strikes and Area Fire attacks deal an additional 1d4 precision damage, and it gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC.

name: Vanguard Comet
description: The Comet is typically operated by a small crew commanded by a low-to-mid ranking officer acting as captain. Comets are bulkier than Harriers and can take more of a beating, so they can be deployed on longer missions. A Comet’s combat potential depends on the gumption and skills of its crew. To make up for what a crew might lack, Vanguard Craftworks unleashed a special new model created in collaboration with engineers from Klokworx. The new Vanguard Comet can deploy drones and munitions empowered by divine sigil tech to shoot wicked lightning bolts at foes. With these turrets, it has seen great success in battling large groups of smaller Veskarium starships during their first clashes.

specialAbilities.name: Deploy Turret
specialAbilities.effect: The Vanguard Comet deploys a turret in its zone. The turret is a tiny starship object with AC 20, 10 HP, Hardness 5, and object immunities. The Vanguard Comet can only have four deployed turrets at a given time. If it would deploy a fifth, one of its previously deployed turrets is destroyed.

specialAbilities.name: Fire Turret
specialAbilities.effect: Each turret of the Vanguard Comet’s choice within sensor range targets a starship in the turret’s zone. Multiple turrets can’t target the same starship. The targets take 3d6 electricity damage with a DC 31 basic Reflex save.

specialAbilities.name: Mobile Aeon Turret
specialAbilities.effect: The Vanguard Comet Boosts Thrusters and can move each of its turrets within sensor range 1 zone.

name: Harpoon-Class Blockade Vessel
description: These vessels were designed to prevent enemy ships from fleeing Gideron Authority starship formations. To accomplish this goal, they use massive harpoons in conjunction with heavy weapons. Blockade Vessels are typically accompanied by several Attack Vessels to help finish the job after they’ve harpooned a target.

specialAbilities.name: Engaged Strike
specialAbilities.effect: This starship attempts a ramming prow Strike against the triggering starship.
specialAbilities.trigger: A starship in the same zone moves to another zone

specialAbilities.name: Ambush from Hell
specialAbilities.effect: The Sword-Class Attack Vessel efficiently stores and recycles the ambient magical energy in Hell while traveling with its Helldrive. Surrounded by Hellish imagery and fire, it rushes forward and assails a foe. It Boosts Thrusters and makes a Strike against a starship. The Strike deals an additional 1 fire damage per weapon damage die, and if it hits, the Sword-Class Attack Vessel attempts an Intimidation check to Demoralize the target. The Sword-Class Attack Vessel can’t use Ambush from Hell until it travels to Hell again.

specialAbilities.name: Tethered Harpoon
specialAbilities.effect: The Harpoon-Class Blockade Vessel fires a massive harpoon attached to a cable at a target within 4 zones. The target must attempt a DC 20 Reflex save; it gains a +2 status bonus to this save if it has any Shield Points. On a failure, the harpoon attaches to the target, which takes a –2-zone circumstance penalty to its Speed and a –2 circumstance penalty to Piloting checks and DCs until it detaches the harpoon. The target can detach the harpoon by succeeding at a DC 20 Piloting check; it can attempt this check as a single action that’s a pilot’s console station action or as a free action it can take whenever it moves at least 1 zone.

name: Hivebound Propagator
description: Much as a Clustership is made up of dozens of smaller components, most of a Propagator’s biomass consists of several Clusterships that can be dislodged to function as individual units. The Propagator evolved to emit special psychic pheromones that drive other Swarm components into a feeding frenzy.

specialAbilities.name: Living Starship
specialAbilities.effect: The starship is a living organism or composed entirely of biomass. A living starship usually has organs or structures instead of battle stations. Living starships don’t have starship immunities.

specialAbilities.name: Dislodge Clustership
specialAbilities.effect: The Propagator shudders as it dislodges a smaller component. It reduces its maximum and current HP each by 28 and becomes clumsy 1 for 1 round. A Hivebound Clustership (see above) appears in the same zone and rolls initiative, taking its turn during the next round of combat; the Clustership is stunned 1 when it appears.

specialAbilities.name: Feeding Frenzy
specialAbilities.effect: The Propagator disperses a haze of pheromones in a zone within sensor range that lasts for 1 round, provoking other swarm ships into a feeding frenzy. Kucharn starships in the zone get a +1 status bonus to melee attack rolls.

name: Infernex Stalwart
description: Orders who take missions in exchange for generous donations often send a group of promising junior to mid-ranking Hellknights in a Stalwart. These orders use these missions as an opportunity to grant junior Hellknights experience and a chance to prove themselves in such a reliable starship.

specialAbilities.name: Kindling of Order
specialAbilities.effect: The Stalwart’s hull ignites into infernal flames. Each non-allied starship within 0 zones takes 4d6 fire damage (DC 18 basic Reflex save). The Stalwart regains Hull Points equal to half the damage it rolls. The Stalwart can’t use Kindling of Order for 1d4 rounds.

specialAbilities.name: Shielding of Law
specialAbilities.effect: The Stalwart and starships of its choice within 0 zones gain 5 Shield Points.

name: Ringworks Scout
description: These simple cruisers make up the bulk of the Stewards’ scouting force. They’re equipped with exceptionally powerful long-range communication arrays, perfect for relaying information back to the Bastion over long distances, and enterprising pilots have also developed techniques to use these arrays offensively. They’re also equipped with a set of maglocks that can hold a criminal in place long enough for more peacekeepers to arrive.

specialAbilities.name: Deploy Maglocks
specialAbilities.effect: The Scout deploys a set of magnetic clamps that latch onto the engines of an enemy starship within 2 zones, preventing the target from escaping. The target must succeed at a DC 20 Piloting check or be immobilized for 1 minute. It can attempt a new Piloting check as a single action with the attack trait to end the effect early.

specialAbilities.name: Scanning Pulse
specialAbilities.effect: The Scout’s scanners release a high-intensity pulse, highlighting potential targets. Enemy starships within sensor range must attempt a DC 20 Will save.

outcomes.success: The starship is immune to the concealed condition for 1 round.
outcomes.failure: The starship is off-guard and immune to the concealed condition for 1 round.
outcomes.criticalFailure: As failure, but the effect lasts for 1 minute.

specialAbilities.name: Scramble Systems
specialAbilities.effect: The Scout targets an enemy starship within sensor range with a blast of comms static. It attempts a Computers check against the target’s Will DC; on a success, one of the target’s battle stations of the Scout’s choice begins malfunctioning, and it takes 2d6 electricity damage. On a critical success, the electricity damage increases to 4d6.

name: UC Bloom
description: Sent to protect at-risk habitats or Xenowarden enclaves, Blooms are bulbous transports sprouting an array of fungal growths and blossoms from their root-veined hulls.

specialAbilities.name: Primal Comms
specialAbilities.effect: The UC Pod’s crew can communicate with starships in sensor range using a primal comms relay incorporated into its magic conduit. Attempting to Hack Comms against a UC Pod requires a Nature check instead of a Computers check.

specialAbilities.name: Living Starship
specialAbilities.effect: The starship is a living organism or composed entirely of biomass. A living starship usually has organs or structures instead of battle stations. Living starships don’t have starship immunities.

specialAbilities.name: Primal Bond
specialAbilities.trigger: The UC Bloom takes damage and has 34 or fewer HP
specialAbilities.effect: The UC Bloom gains fast healing 6, which ends when it has 35 or more Hit Points.

specialAbilities.name: Entwined Roots
specialAbilities.effect: The UC Bloom restores 6 HP to a Pollinated starship within sensor range. If any of the crew members on board the target starship are affected by a temporary condition, such as frightened, reduce the value of the condition by 1.

specialAbilities.name: Petal Shields
specialAbilities.effect: The UC Bloom unfurls its petals to block incoming projectiles. The UC Bloom gains 10 SP that last for 1 minute. While it has these SP, Medium and smaller starships behind a UC Bloom can Stick to Cover (page 208) as a pilot’s console station action (even if the starship doesn’t normally have the Stick to Cover action).

specialAbilities.name: Pollinate
specialAbilities.effect: The UC Bloom releases nanomachines that attach to a starship in sensor range and transmit a magical homing signal. An unwilling target must succeed a DC 18 Will save to resist being pollinated.

name: Cloak-Class Ambassador Vessel
description: Gideron propaganda claims that Cloak-Class Ambassador Vessels are “spy ships,” and it isn’t entirely wrong. The Marixah Republic uses these ships for diplomatic missions, but their stealth equipment also helps them bypass Gideron blockades.

specialAbilities.name: Raise Cloak
specialAbilities.requirements: The Cloak-Class Ambassador Vessel has at least 1 Shield Point
specialAbilities.effect: The Cloak-Class Ambassador Vessel charges its shields with a field of concealing energy. It’s invisible to other starships’ sensors until the end of its next turn or until it takes a hostile action, whichever happens first.

specialAbilities.name: Run Blockade
specialAbilities.effect: The BD Freighter diverts power to its generator and Boosts Thrusters while performing evasive maneuvers. This movement doesn’t trigger reactions, and the BD Freighter gains a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and Reflex saves until the start of its next turn.

name: Jinsul Carrier
description: The heart of any jinsul expeditionary force, a Jinsul Carrier is commanded by a single pontiff, relaying the commands of the larger Hierocracy to the rest of the fleet. Powerful shield generators protect breacher crews as they fight for the cause, while bays of servitor drones reinforce their limited crew strength with deadly bladed arms.

specialAbilities.name: Command Servitor Drone
specialAbilities.effect: One servitor drone within sensors moves up to 2 zones, then swings its bladed arms against an enemy within 0 zones. The target takes 2d10 slashing damage (DC 22 basic Reflex save).

specialAbilities.name: Deploy Servitor Drone
specialAbilities.effect: The Jinsul Carrier deploys a servitor drone in its zone. The servitor drone is a tiny starship object with AC 22, 15 HP, Hardness 5, and object immunities. The Jinsul Carrier can have only four deployed servitor drones at a given time. If it would deploy a fifth, one of its previously deployed servitor drones is destroyed.

specialAbilities.name: Pontiff’s Blessing
specialAbilities.effect: The Jinsul Carrier transfers any number of Shield Points from itself to a servitor drone or jinsul starship within sensor range.

name: Skyfire Star Dragon
description: The Skyfire Legion of Triaxus are known for riding dragons into battle. A Star Dragon refers to a dragon with a single rider trained to fight starships and other cosmic threats.

specialAbilities.name: Drift Sense
specialAbilities.effect: The dragon can always sense the distance and direction to the nearest Drift beacon and to the Starstone on Absalom Station.

specialAbilities.name: Attunement Aura
specialAbilities.effect: 1 zone. Allied starships in the aura gain a +1-zone status bonus to Speed (if dragon is photon-attuned), or enemies take a –1-zone status penalty to Speed (if dragon is graviton-attuned). These effects apply at the start of the starship’s turn and end at the start of its next turn.

specialAbilities.name: Living Starship
specialAbilities.effect: The starship is a living organism or composed entirely of biomass. A living starship usually has organs or structures instead of battle stations. Living starships don’t have starship immunities.

specialAbilities.name: Engaged Strike
specialAbilities.effect: This starship attempts a claw Strike against the triggering starship.
specialAbilities.trigger: A starship in the same zone moves to another zone

specialAbilities.name: Cosmic Attunement
specialAbilities.effect: The dragon is always attuned to an underlying stellar force: either photons or gravitons. They can swap attunement as a free action once at the start of their turn in combat and is otherwise attuned to whichever force they choose at any time outside of combat. While photon-attuned, the dragon’s melee Strikes deal an additional 2d6 fire damage; while graviton-attuned, their melee Strikes deal additional 1d6 bludgeoning damage plus the target becomes off-guard until the end of the dragon’s current turn. The damage of their cosmic blast Strike is determined by their current attunement (fire for photons and bludgeoning for gravitons), as are the effects of some of their other abilities.

specialAbilities.name: Draconic Frenzy
specialAbilities.effect: The dragon makes two claw Strikes and one tail Strike in any order.

specialAbilities.name: Draconic Momentum
specialAbilities.effect: The dragon recharges their Stellar Breath whenever they score a critical hit with a Strike.

specialAbilities.name: Stellar Breath
specialAbilities.effect: The dragon unleashes divine power like that from the core of a star or black hole, dealing 4d10 cold damage in a 1-zone cone (DC 22 basic Will save). Starships immune to cold damage take bludgeoning or fire damage instead (see cosmic attunement). The dragon can’t use Stellar Breath for 1d4 rounds.

name: Soul Harvest Necrofighter
description: Soul Harvest Necrofighters are always helmed by intelligent undead who have a Corpse Fleet rank.

specialAbilities.name: Harvest Soul
specialAbilities.trigger: A living creature dies on a starship within sensor range
specialAbilities.effect: The Soul Harvest Necrofighter immediately performs the create undead ritual on the triggering creature, as if it were a 2nd-rank spell with a casting time of a reaction and the Soul Harvest Necrofighter rolled a critical success on the ritual.

specialAbilities.name: Steal Life
specialAbilities.requirements: The Soul Harvest Necrofighter’s last action this turn was a successful grave disruptor rifle Strike against a starship within sensor range
specialAbilities.effect: Each creature helming a battle station on the required starship takes 2d6 void damage (DC 22 basic Will save). It can restore Shield Points equal to the half the damage it dealt this way, distributing it among starships within 0 zones.

name: Vanguard Monitor
description: Vanguard Monitors are the latest version of a classic starship model designed for scouting behind enemy lines. Far from the most powerful vessel the empire is capable of producing, Monitors are the eyes of the Azlanti star fleet. Sovereign Monitors were among the first Aeon Guard units to be captured, destroyed, or sabotaged after Sihedron Guard forces seized the Imperial Foundry. Ishmerai Ophir personally blesses each newly manufactured Monitor with a protection sigil—though lesser priests take on this duty when his holiness is otherwise occupied. After Ishmerai’s coup against the Aeon Throne, Vanguard Craftworks refused any further orders to produce more starships for the Sihedron fleet. To add injury to insult, the heads of the Arioch and Oyadae noble families delivered their response to New Thespera via self-destructing drone. Ishmerai’s bodyguards intercepted it before it could harm its target.

specialAbilities.name: Protection Sigil
specialAbilities.effect: A seven-pointed sigil blazes as divine energy surrounds the hull. The starship gains resistance 3 against the triggering damage type for 1 minute.
specialAbilities.trigger: The starship takes damage

specialAbilities.name: Concealing Maneuver
specialAbilities.requirements: There’s a Medium or larger starship or hazard in the Vanguard Monitor’s zone
specialAbilities.effect: The Vanguard Monitor gains a +2 circumstance bonus to its AC against starships in a direction of its choice on the sensor map as it takes cover, and it attempts to Hide from starships it has a circumstance bonus to AC against.

specialAbilities.name: Lissala’s Eye
specialAbilities.effect: The starship emits a harmless laser beam that plants a unique signal onto a target within sensor range. The affected starship must attempt a Will save. On a failure, the target becomes off-guard to all the starship’s allies within sensor range for 1 round. On a critical failure, the target can’t benefit from cover against starships it’s off-guard to in this way.

specialAbilities.name: Vanish From Sensors
specialAbilities.effect: The Vanguard Monitor becomes invisible to other starships until the end of its next turn or it takes a hostile action, whichever happens first.

name: Dashadz Wayfarer
description: While older models of the Wayfarer lack the firepower typical of Veskarium-manufactured starships, manufacturer Dashadz has responded to escalating intergalactic conflicts by including an impressive array of weaponry in its latest Gen-8 models. These maneuverable vessels, originally based on a design for military transports, became widespread in the Veskarium and Pact Worlds after tensions eased between them and have since spread across Near Space.

specialAbilities.name: Dashadz Durability
specialAbilities.effect: The Dashadz Wayfarer is more durable than it looks—and it looks extremely durable. The first time the Dashadz wayfarer is reduced to 0 Hull Points, it’s instead reduced to 1 Hull Point and regains 10 Shield Points. It can’t benefit from Dashadz durability again until repaired at an appropriate starship facility, a process requiring 1 day of work.

specialAbilities.name: Eject Garbage
specialAbilities.effect: The Dashadz Wayfarer engages its garbage ejection system, spewing weaponized debris behind it. All starships in a 2-zone cone in the opposite direction of the Wayfarer’s heading take 7d6 bludgeoning damage with a DC 21 basic Reflex save. Entering an affected zone costs an extra 1 zone of movement for 1 round.

specialAbilities.name: Engage Lateral Thrusters
specialAbilities.effect: The Dashadz Wayfarer moves up to its Speed in any direction.

name: Inheritorworks Shieldcraft
description: Where Brightswords are the blade of the Knights, Shieldcrafts are their impenetrable shield. Equipped with a crew of Iomedaean clerics, their divine magic conduits allow them to create spectral copies of their shields to protect allies unequipped with their own generators. Their defensive focus makes them no less effective in combat, however; the great reinforced spike mounted to the prow of a Shieldcraft is just as effective as any hardlight blade.

specialAbilities.name: Boost Shields
specialAbilities.requirements: The Shieldcraft has at least 1 Shield Point
specialAbilities.effect: The Shieldcraft gains a +2 circumstance bonus to its AC until the start of its next turn or until it’s reduced to 0 Shield Points.

specialAbilities.name: Ramming Speed
specialAbilities.effect: The Shieldcraft flies at a target and crashes into it with an ornate, hardlight ramming prow. The Shieldcraft Boosts Thrusters twice, then makes a ramming prow Strike.

specialAbilities.name: Shield Wall
specialAbilities.requirements: The Shieldcraft has a circumstance bonus to its AC from Boost Shields
specialAbilities.effect: With a ritual prayer to Iomedae, the Shieldcraft extends its shields to cover its compatriots. Allies within 0 zones gain a +1 circumstance bonus to their AC for the duration of Boost Shields.

name: Raider Heartbreaker
description: The Heartbreaker is one of the more technically impressive models of the Raider line of starships. Within its small chassis, it stores a powerful computer that can disrupt even the most secure of systems, and its chainsaw prow is specially modified to conduct comms signals along the blade, directly attacking its victims’ systems. It’s a rare sight among most Free Captain crews due to the high level of technological know-how required to pilot it, but it’s an even rarer sight to witness a crew with a Heartbreaker fail on a job.

specialAbilities.name: Chainsaw Prow
specialAbilities.effect: The Free Captain starship sinks its rotating blades into the hull of a starship within 0 zones. The target takes 2d8+5 slashing damage with a basic Fortitude save against DC 22. If Chainsaw Prow deals damage to the target’s Hull Points, and the target is larger than the Free Captain starship, the Free Captain starship clings to the target. Until the start of the Free Captain starship’s next turn, it moves with the target whenever the target moves.

specialAbilities.name: Static Burst
specialAbilities.effect: The Heartbreaker’s computer performs an all-out attack on the systems of a starship within sensor range. The target takes 4d6 electricity damage with a DC 23 Will save; if the Heartbreaker is clinging to the target using its Chainsaw Prow, the target takes a –2 circumstance penalty to this saving throw.

outcomes.failure: The target takes full damage and suffers a –1 status penalty to its AC and attack rolls until the end of the Heartbreaker’s next turn.
outcomes.criticalFailure: As failure, but the target takes double damage, and the status penalty is –2.

name: SFS Moonhopper
description: While lacking the industrial capacity of a megacorporation, the Starfinder Society’s expert agents and accumulation of alien technology have produced a versatile fleet of highly customized starships. Using tech from across Near Space, the Moonhopper is a simple, short-range convoy starship converted into a highly maneuverable, two-person fighter. Perhaps leaked intentionally to crowdsource potential design flaws, several imitators of this starship are now available on the open market using its iconic shield draining technology.

specialAbilities.name: Engaged Strike
specialAbilities.effect: This starship attempts a shield bash Strike against the triggering starship.
specialAbilities.trigger: A starship in the same zone moves to another zone

specialAbilities.name: Overclock Shield
specialAbilities.effect: Lower the number of Shield Points the Moonhopper has by 15. The next time this turn the Moonhopper makes a shield bash Strike, it deals an additional 3d6 electricity damage.

specialAbilities.name: Shield Drain
specialAbilities.effect: The Moonhopper’s iconic shield-draining technology makes it a powerful tool for Starfinders. The first time each turn that the Moonhopper successfully hits a target with its shield bash, it gains SP equal to the number of SP its target lost, up to the Moonhopper’s fortify value.

name: Aspis Moonlighter
description: While all official documentation describes the Moonlighter as the ideal freighter to evade pirates, its true capabilities in espionage, sabotage, and smuggling are known throughout the Pact Worlds.

specialAbilities.name: Smuggler Compartment
specialAbilities.effect: The Moonlighter has a secure compartment below the main deck for cargo, which scanners have trouble detecting due to the hull’s shape. The compartment can hold up to 48 Bulk. Creatures gain a +4 circumstance bonus to Stealth checks and DCs to hide or conceal themselves or equipment in this compartment.

specialAbilities.name: Cloak Starship
specialAbilities.effect: The Aspis Moonlighter becomes invisible for 1 hour. This makes it undetected to all starships, though starships can attempt to Seek Starships against it, making it hidden to them instead. If the Moonlighter uses a hostile action, the invisibility ends after that hostile action is completed.

specialAbilities.name: Stealth Torpedo System
specialAbilities.effect: These large missiles are invisible until they explode and firing them doesn’t end the Moonlighter’s Cloak Starship ability. As long as the Moonlighter is invisible, only enemies who can see the Moonlighter can use reactions against the Area Fire of a wraith torpedo.

name: Idaran Cantripper
description: Kasathan starship technology advances in unexpected leaps and bounds as the ancient technology of the Idari is successfully reverse engineered. For the Idaran Cantripper, a team of kasathan engineers and technomancers from the Arcanamirium successfully deciphered the secrets of a compact magic conduit, allowing them to develop a highly maneuverable, single-pilot starship with a functioning magic conduit.

specialAbilities.name: Nova Ball
specialAbilities.effect: The Cantripper creates an explosion mimicking the death of a star in a zone within sensor range. Starships in that zone take 6d6 fire damage (DC 24 basic Reflex save).

name: SC Vaultship
description: Heavily fortified Vaultships haul valuable cargo, such as szandite crystals, metals and minerals, research findings, and personnel, across Collective space. In an emergency, Vaultships allow for swift evacuation of Szandite Collective planets or space stations.

specialAbilities.name: Szandite Crystal Comms
specialAbilities.effect: The SC Jackknife can communicate with other Szandite Collective starships or settlements at any distance using its onboard szandite crystals, which allow for instant mental communication to other szandite crystals.

specialAbilities.name: Slow and Steady
specialAbilities.effect: The SC Vaultship is immune to penalties to its Speed and to the immobilized condition, and it ignores effects that increase its movement cost.

name: Dread Dominator
description: The Sovereign Dominator has recently become a prominent weapon of the Azlanti Star Empire’s fleet, and enterprising Free Captains have wasted no time in finding opportunities to isolate and capture these advanced vessels. Still equipped with their powerful polarizing beam, with the added danger of a haphazardly welded-on harpoon launcher and the raider beam, so-called “Dread Dominators” are just as much of a threat as those fielded by the Azlanti.

specialAbilities.name: Piercing Harpoon
specialAbilities.effect: The Free Captain starship launches a harpoon at another starship within 1 zone. The target starship takes 3d8 piercing damage and attempts a Fortitude save against DC 23.

outcomes.failure: The target takes full damage, and the Free Captain starship chooses a battle station on the target starship to become malfunctioning.
outcomes.criticalFailure: The target takes double damage, and the Free Captain starship chooses a battle station on the target to become malfunctioning. Additionally, the harpoon causes a Hull Breach hazard (page 251) to appear in a space adjacent to the malfunctioning battle station.

specialAbilities.name: Raider Beam
specialAbilities.effect: The Dominator emits a harmless laser beam that plants a unique signal onto a starship within sensor range. The target must attempt a DC 23 Will save. On a failure, it becomes off-guard to the Dominator and its allies within sensor range for 1 round. On a critical failure, the target also can’t benefit from cover against starships it’s off-guard to for the duration.

specialAbilities.name: Wave Holo-Roger
specialAbilities.effect: A Free Captain starship’s holo-roger is a sight that gives rise to courage in the hearts of its allies. Allied creatures and starships within sensor range of the starship gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Will saves against fear effects for 1 round.

name: Norikama Dropship
description: Manufactured by the Norikama Syndicate, this vessel is styled as a miniature version of a large Veskarium warship. Norikama Dropships are personnel transports that can hold their own in a fight. Once disdained as copycats and looters of the honorable dead, the Norikama Syndicate’s reputation has rapidly changed in the Veskarium since the start of the Azlanti war. The Conqueror’s Forge can’t keep up with the demand for new battle-ready craft and have called upon every civilian manufacturer to join the war effort. Norikama answered with a new version of their iconic dropship.

specialAbilities.name: Electromagnetic Pulse
specialAbilities.effect: The Norikama Dropship releases a disrupting pulse that targets enemy scanners. All other starships in the Norikama Dropship’s zone take 4d4 electricity damage based on the results of a DC 23 Will save.

outcomes.criticalSuccess: The target is unaffected and is immune to Electromagnetic Pulse for 24 hours.
outcomes.failure: The target takes full damage, and the target’s scanner is malfunctioning for 1 round.
outcomes.criticalFailure: The target takes double damage, and the target’s scanner is malfunctioning for 1 minute.

specialAbilities.name: Merciless Aim
specialAbilities.effect: The BMC Mauler locks onto a starship in sensor range. While locked-on, the target takes a –1 status penalty to its AC and Reflex saves against the BMC Mauler until the end of the BMC Mauler’s next turn or until it’s targeted by an attack from one of the BMC Mauler’s gunneries, whichever happens first.

name: Skyfire Galactic Dragon
description: Skyfire Galactic Dragons are crewed by multiple members of the Skyfire Legion, including their bonded rider and adventurers.

specialAbilities.name: Drift Sense
specialAbilities.effect: The dragon can always sense the distance and direction to the nearest Drift beacon and to the Starstone on Absalom Station.

specialAbilities.name: Attunement Aura
specialAbilities.effect: 1 zone. Allied starships in the aura gain a +1-zone status bonus to Speed (if dragon is photon-attuned), or enemies take a –1-zone status penalty to Speed (if dragon is graviton-attuned). These effects apply at the start of the starship’s turn and end at the start of its next turn.

specialAbilities.effect: The starship is a living organism or composed entirely of biomass. A living starship usually has organs or structures instead of battle stations. Living starships don’t have starship immunities.

specialAbilities.effect: This starship attempts a claw Strike against the triggering starship.
specialAbilities.trigger: A starship in the same zone moves to another zone

They can swap attunement as a free action once at the start of their turn in combat and is otherwise attuned to whichever force they choose at any time outside of combat.
