The damage of their cosmic blast Strike is determined by their current attunement (fire for photons and bludgeoning for gravitons), as are the effects of some of their other abilities.

specialAbilities.name: Draconic Frenzy
specialAbilities.effect: The dragon makes two claw Strikes and one tail Strike in any order.

specialAbilities.name: Draconic Momentum
specialAbilities.effect: The dragon recharges their Stellar Breath whenever they score a critical hit with a Strike.

specialAbilities.name: Stellar Breath
specialAbilities.effect: As Skyfire Star Dragon, but a 2-zone cone, 6d10 cold damage, and DC 26.

name: Skyfire Trident
description: The Skyfire Trident is a model that Star Dragons have developed to be able to fly and battle side-by-side with their bonded partners as equals. A Star Dragon who wishes to fly alongside their partner spends several weeks in isolation, crafting a personalized Trident starship, which they then gift to their bonded partner.

specialAbilities.name: Engaged Strike
specialAbilities.effect: This starship attempts a draconic javelin Strike against the triggering starship.
specialAbilities.trigger: A starship in the same zone moves to another zone

specialAbilities.name: Drill Dive
specialAbilities.effect: The Trident Boosts Thrusters, barreling toward its foe. If the Trident moves at least 1 zone, a starship within 0 zones takes 3d12 piercing damage and must attempt a DC 24 Fortitude save.

outcomes.success: The target takes half damage and is off-guard to the next Strike the Trident makes against it for 1 round.
outcomes.failure: The target takes full damage. It’s off-kilter and off- guard while it’s off-kilter.
outcomes.criticalFailure: The target takes double damage. It’s off-kilter and off-guard while it’s off-kilter. The Trident can push the target back 1 zone in the direction of the Trident’s heading.

specialAbilities.name: Stellar Breath
specialAbilities.effect: As Skyfire Star Dragon, but a 2-zone cone, 6d10 cold damage, and DC 26.

name: Sovereign Dominator
description: Dominators typically fly solo to lock down key objectives while a battle rages elsewhere, or they might accompany a larger force as scouts and spies that can infiltrate enemy formations to wreak havoc.

specialAbilities.name: Dominate Station
specialAbilities.effect: The Sovereign Dominator’s sophisticated scanners scramble and break the battle stations of a starship within sensor range. The target starship attempts a DC 23 Will save. On a failure, all the target starship’s battle stations are malfunctioning.

specialAbilities.name: Issue Threat
specialAbilities.effect: The Sovereign Dominator opens a one-way channel with a starship within sensor range, then attempts to Demoralize each enemy creature on board the starship.

specialAbilities.name: Lissala’s Eye
specialAbilities.effect: The starship emits a harmless laser beam that plants a unique signal onto a target within sensor range. The affected starship must attempt a Will save. On a failure, the target becomes off-guard to all the starship’s allies within sensor range for 1 round. On a critical failure, the target can’t benefit from cover against starships it’s off-guard to in this way.

name: Steward Ambassador
description: Ambassadors are most often seen in parades and airshows, where their flashy holoprojectors and powerful engines make for thrilling displays of the pilots’ skill. This fact has earned them a reputation for being all flash and no substance, but despite the spectacle, their warlance is no less deadly when it pierces through another starship’s hull in a single charge.

specialAbilities.name: Dramatic Wheel
specialAbilities.trigger: The Ambassador is reduced to 0 Shield Points
specialAbilities.effect: The Ambassador wheels around in a dramatic display, shaking off the blow by showing its skill. It attempts a DC 26 Piloting check; on a success, it Changes Heading and Boosts Thrusters.

specialAbilities.name: Jousting Charge
specialAbilities.effect: The Ambassador flares its thrusters and tears through foes with its lance. It Boosts Thrusters twice; at any point during this movement, it can make a warlance Strike. If it moved at least 2 zones before making this Strike, it gains a +2 circumstance bonus to the attack roll, and the Strike deals an additional 1d8 piercing damage.

specialAbilities.name: Raise Holo-Banner
specialAbilities.effect: The Ambassador displays a heroic holo-banner featuring the Stewards’ colors, declaring an enemy within sensor range as its foe. If it hits its foe with a Strike before the start of its next turn, the Ambassador and its allies within sensor range gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls for 1 round. If it doesn’t, the Ambassador (but not its allies) takes a –1 status penalty instead.

name: UC Gardenship
description: Xenowardens aboard a UC Bloom starship bond with it, and as more people bond with it over time, the Bloom starship grows much larger and bears fruit, becoming known as a Gardenship once they reach a certain size threshold. A Gardenship disperses seeds capable of exploding on command. Xenowarden enclaves are often surrounded by a field of natural orbital mines placed by the Gardenships that carried the Xenowardens who established the enclave.

specialAbilities.name: Primal Comms
specialAbilities.effect: The UC Pod’s crew can communicate with starships in sensor range using a primal comms relay incorporated into its magic conduit. Attempting to Hack Comms against a UC Pod requires a Nature check instead of a Computers check.

specialAbilities.name: Living Starship
specialAbilities.effect: The starship is a living organism or composed entirely of biomass. A living starship usually has organs or structures instead of battle stations. Living starships don’t have starship immunities.

specialAbilities.name: Primal Bond
specialAbilities.trigger: The UC Gardenship takes damage and has 83 or fewer HP
specialAbilities.effect: The UC Gardenship gains fast healing 10, which ends when it has 84 or more Hit Points.

specialAbilities.name: Deploy Seed
specialAbilities.effect: The Gardenship deploys a seed in its zone. The seed is a small starship object with AC 20, 10 HP, Hardness 5, and object immunities. The Gardenship can have only three deployed seeds at a given time. If it would deploy a fourth, one of its previously deployed seeds is destroyed.

specialAbilities.name: Seed Migration
specialAbilities.effect: One deployed seed moves up to 2 zones within the Gardenship’s sensor range.

specialAbilities.name: Verdant Growth
specialAbilities.effect: The Gardenship orders a deployed seed within sensor range to burst into unnatural plant growth. Starships in the seed’s zone take 5d6 piercing damage (DC 25 basic Reflex save).

name: Barrow Eulogy
description: The Barrow Eulogy is a potent recruiting model, aiding its allies on board the starships of the living. A Eulogy typically reveals itself only after a boarding pod (page 250) has successfully landed on an enemy starship.

specialAbilities.name: Command Infantry
specialAbilities.effect: The Barrow Eulogy emits void energy at a starship within sensor range. Each undead creature on board the target starship can Stride as a reaction.

specialAbilities.name: Invigorate Infantry
specialAbilities.effect: The Eulogy restores 2d6 Hit Points to each undead creature on board a starship within sensor range.

name: Converted Dreadnought
description: While most Swarm starships are unique components evolved for that purpose, the Swarm isn’t above repurposing the engineering work of others to achieve its own ends. After the crew of an Azlanti or Veskarium dreadnought is slain, Swarm components proceed to fill its halls and fighter bays with a tracery of hives and flesh, reanimating the stolen vessel as a terrifyingly effective component in its own right.

specialAbilities.name: Discharge Swarmlings
specialAbilities.effect: The Dreadnought releases a swarm of tiny, short-lived components from the hives that clog its fighter bays. Starships in a 1-zone emanation take 4d8 acid damage (DC 28 basic Fortitude save). On a failed save, they’re also off-guard until the end of the Dreadnought’s next turn.

specialAbilities.name: Hundredfold Laser Barrage
specialAbilities.effect: The Dreadnought’s commandeered laser cannons unleash a fusillade of fire. Starships in a 2-zone cone take 6d6 fire damage (DC 28 basic Reflex save).

specialAbilities.name: Ultimate Mindwarp Cannon
specialAbilities.effect: The Dreadnought concentrates the full force of its colony mind through its spinal weapon, releasing a wave of psychic force in a 6-zone line in the direction of its heading. Starships in the area take 12d8 mental damage with a DC 30 basic Will save. On a failure, each member of the starship’s crew becomes frightened 1 (frightened 2 on a critical failure); this is an emotion, fear, and mental effect.

name: Pentacorn
description: Pentacorn is just as infamous as its captain, Loa-5, but despite this notoriety, there are no reputable stories about its appearance. The legendary starship is equipped with an advanced cloaking field—supposedly stolen from a high-tech lab in the Shadari Confederacy—that’s rarely disengaged. Only the captain’s victims can say they’ve seen Pentacorn’s true form, and none have lived to tell the tale.

specialAbilities.name: Disruptive Shields
specialAbilities.trigger: Pentacorn takes damage to its Shield Points from an enemy
specialAbilities.effect: Pentacorn’s shields discharge disruptive energy. The triggering enemy must succeed at a DC 29 Reflex save or take 4d6 electricity damage; on a failure, the enemy also takes a –2-zone status penalty to its Speed for 1 round.

specialAbilities.name: Cloaking Field
specialAbilities.effect: Pentacorn becomes hidden for 1 minute. The effect ends if Pentacorn takes damage or uses a hostile action.

specialAbilities.name: Vital Strike
specialAbilities.requirements: A starship within 3 zones is off-guard to Pentacorn
specialAbilities.effect: Pentacorn makes a flak autocannon Strike against the required starship. If this Strike hits, it deals an additional 1d12 precision damage, and Pentacorn chooses one of the target’s battle stations to become malfunctioning.

specialAbilities.name: Wave Holo-Roger
specialAbilities.effect: A Free Captain starship’s holo-roger is a sight that gives rise to courage in the hearts of its allies. Allied creatures and starships within sensor range of the starship gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Will saves against fear effects for 1 round.

name: Shadari Voidbringer
description: These powerful ships of the Shadari Confederacy are a rare sight in the Pact Worlds, as few of the followers of Ataxxea have any desire to hasten destruction with open war. Instead, these strange vessels are equipped with entropic technology that allows them to turn attackers’ weapons against their enemies, dissipating energy into the void in another step toward the world’s inevitable end. In a pinch, however, they aren’t above unleashing the powerful beam concealed behind the third eye design on the vessel’s nose.

specialAbilities.name: Entropic Shields
specialAbilities.trigger: The Shadari Voidbringer takes energy damage to its Shield Points
specialAbilities.effect: The Shadari Voidbringer gains resistance 5 to the triggering damage, and its current zone becomes an entropic field that lasts for 1 round. Starships that enter or start their turn in the entropic field take 4d6 damage of the same type as the triggering damage with a DC 28 basic Reflex save.

specialAbilities.name: Entropic Ray
specialAbilities.effect: The Shadari Voidbringer unleashes a blast of entropic energy in a 3-zone line in the direction of its heading. Affected starships take 6d6 acid damage (DC 28 basic Reflex save); on a critical failure, they become off-guard for 1 round.

name: Steward Sentinel
description: Sentinels are the center of any Steward fleet. Their bulk makes them difficult to maneuver, but their unparalleled defensive abilities and highly advanced shields mean they’re well-suited to lead from the front by protecting smaller, more maneuverable craft. Though they’re most known for their defenses, a broadside from their array of heavy lasers is also destructive enough to match the rest of a fleet on its own.

specialAbilities.name: Heroic Defense
specialAbilities.trigger: An ally within 1 zone would take damage
specialAbilities.requirements: The Sentinel has at least 1 Shield Point
specialAbilities.effect: The Sentinel Boosts Thrusters to the same zone as the triggering ally, Changing Heading first if it needs to. The ally gains resistance 10 to the triggering damage, and the Sentinel takes the same amount of damage that was reduced by this resistance.

specialAbilities.name: Boost Shields
specialAbilities.requirements: The Sentinel has at least 1 Shield Point
specialAbilities.effect: The Sentinel gains a +2 circumstance bonus to its AC until the start of its next turn or until it’s reduced to 0 Shield Points.

specialAbilities.name: Laser Fusillade
specialAbilities.effect: The Sentinel unleashes a fusillade of laser blasts. It makes four Strikes with its heavy laser, each with its current multiple attack penalty. It takes a –5 circumstance penalty to its attack roll for each of these Strikes.

specialAbilities.name: Stellar Bastion
specialAbilities.effect: The Sentinel sends its shields to its allies, protecting them at the cost of its own defenses. It loses Shield Points equal to its current Shield Points, and each ally within sensor range gains half that many Shield Points.

name: Infernex Justiciar
description: The Infernex Justiciar is designed to hunt and destroy the most dangerous enemies of a Hellknight order.

specialAbilities.name: Infernal Cloak
specialAbilities.effect: The Infernex Justiciar becomes invisible for 1 hour. This makes it undetected to all starships, though starships can attempt to Seek Starships against it, making it hidden to them instead. If the invisible starship uses a hostile action, the invisibility ends after that hostile action is completed.

specialAbilities.name: Infernal Hunter
specialAbilities.effect: Once per week, the Infernex Justiciar can teleport to its marked target’s zone.

specialAbilities.name: Infernal Mark
specialAbilities.effect: The Infernex Justiciar brands a starship in sensor range with an infernal mark. The Infernex Justiciar gains a +1 status bonus to attack rolls to Strike the marked target. The infernal mark can only be removed by destroying the Justiciar or by counteracting it, such as with dispel magic or similar effects (6th rank; DC 29).

specialAbilities.name: Punish the Guilty
specialAbilities.effect: The first time the Infernex Justiciar hits a target branded with its infernal mark each round, it deals an additional 1d8 precision damage.

specialAbilities.name: Tractor Beam
specialAbilities.effect: A target within 2 zones must attempt a Fortitude save.

outcomes.success: The target takes a –1-zone status penalty to its Speed for 1 round.
outcomes.failure: The target is pulled 1 zone closer to the starship, and it takes a –1-zone status penalty to its Speed for 1 round.
outcomes.criticalFailure: The target is pulled 2 zones closer to the starship, and it takes a –2-zone status penalty to its Speed for 1 round.

name: Raider Starcrusher
description: Like the Heartbreaker, the Raider Starcrusher represents a technological leap in the output of Broken Rock Oath’s foundries. Its advanced magic conduit links directing to its vicious harpoon, channeling deadly electricity directly into an impaled target. The magic conduits can also be discharged all at once to create a miniature supernova, trapping targets in place just long enough to capture them and raid their cargo holds.

specialAbilities.name: Charge Harpoon
specialAbilities.effect: The Starcrusher links its harpoon with its magic conduit, charging it with deadly electricity. If its next action is to use Piercing Harpoon, it deals an additional 3d6 electricity damage, and the target takes a –1-zone status penalty to its Speed on a failed save.

specialAbilities.name: Cosmic Crush
specialAbilities.effect: The Starcrusher generates a blazing miniature star in a zone within sensor range that rapidly collapses into a black hole. Starships in the targeted zone take 5d6 fire damage and 5d6 bludgeoning damage (DC 30 basic Reflex save). On a failed save, affected starships are immobilized until the end of their next turn.

specialAbilities.name: Piercing Harpoon
specialAbilities.effect: The Free Captain starship launches a harpoon at another starship within 1 zone. The target starship takes 5d8 piercing damage and attempts a Fortitude save against DC 30.

outcomes.failure: The target takes full damage, and the Free Captain starship chooses a battle station on the target starship to become malfunctioning.
outcomes.criticalFailure: The target takes double damage, and the Free Captain starship chooses a battle station on the target to become malfunctioning. Additionally, the harpoon causes a Hull Breach hazard (page 251) to appear in a space adjacent to the malfunctioning battle station.

name: Symbiotic Oma
description: Known as space whales, omas are enormous cosmic creatures who travel the stars and feed off the dense atmospheres of gas giants. Barathu explorers have used them as living starships for generations, relying on biomechanical augmentations to greatly enhance omas’ capabilities and make journeys more comfortable.

specialAbilities.name: Starsong
specialAbilities.effect: See oma (Starfinder Alien Core 127).

specialAbilities.name: Living Starship
specialAbilities.effect: The starship is a living organism or composed entirely of biomass. A living starship usually has organs or structures instead of battle stations. Living starships don’t have starship immunities.

specialAbilities.name: Cavatina
specialAbilities.effect: See oma (Starfinder Alien Core 127), DC 30, range 1 zone.

specialAbilities.name: Overloading Strike
specialAbilities.effect: When an oma critically hits with its electrostatic discharge Strike, the target must succeed at a DC 30 basic Reflex save or one battle station on the starship of the oma’s choice becomes malfunctioning.

specialAbilities.name: Swallow Starship
specialAbilities.effect: The oma attempts to swallow whole another starship within 0 zones. The target must attempt a DC 30 Reflex save or become swallowed. While swallowed, the starship is immobilized, the oma is off-guard to it, it can target only the oma with any of its abilities, and it can’t be targeted by effects from starships that aren’t swallowed by the oma. Damage dealt against the oma by a starship it has swallowed doesn’t damage its SP but directly damages its HP instead. A creature helming the pilot’s console can attempt a DC 30 Piloting check as a single action that’s a pilot console station action to stop being swallowed. Alternatively, if the starship deals 26 damage to the oma in a single turn, it stops being swallowed. While the oma has a starship swallowed, if it has crew members in its stomach, the oma can spend a single action once per turn to board the swallowed starship with a creature that’s 3 or more levels lower than the oma.

name: UC Arkship
description: Arkships are the pinnacle of a UC starship’s life cycle. Most seeds planted in UC orbital nurseries grow into Pods, Blooms, or other potential physiologies, as determined by the bioengineers who created them. Some are selected for metamorphosis into mighty Arkships. If needed, multiple Pods can merge to form an Arkship large enough to carry a Xenowarden expedition.

specialAbilities.name: Primal Comms
specialAbilities.effect: The UC Pod’s crew can communicate with starships in sensor range using a primal comms relay incorporated into its magic conduit. Attempting to Hack Comms against a UC Pod requires a Nature check instead of a Computers check.

specialAbilities.name: Living Starship
specialAbilities.effect: The starship is a living organism or composed entirely of biomass. A living starship usually has organs or structures instead of battle stations. Living starships don’t have starship immunities.

specialAbilities.name: Primal Bond
specialAbilities.trigger: The UC Arkship takes damage and has 95 or fewer HP
specialAbilities.effect: The UC Arkship gains fast healing 20, which ends when it has 96 HP or more Hit Points.

specialAbilities.name: Deploy Thorn Barrier
specialAbilities.effect: The Arkship plants a barrier of rapidly propagating thorny vegetation between two zones within sensor range. Everything on either side of the barrier has cover from starships on the opposite side. All starships in the zones adjacent to the barrier when it’s first planted and starships that move through the barrier take 6d6 piercing damage (DC 28 basic Reflex save). The barrier is a starship object and has AC 10, 86 HP, and Hardness 10; it has object immunities and is immune to critical damage. It can also be targeted by any effects that can target a starship in either zone it’s adjacent to.

specialAbilities.name: Primal Astrofire
specialAbilities.effect: The UC Arkship blasts a zone in sensor range with primal flame, dealing 6d6 fire damage in a 2-zone burst (DC 30 basic Fortitude save).

name: AAC Vigilance
description: Manufactured by the Allied Arms Corporation (AAC) of Triaxus, the Vigilance is the top-of-the-line, high-end fighter of the Skyfire Legion’s mercenary fleet. Capable of incredible maneuvering and operated only by aces who have proven themselves in battle, these ships are usually piloted by a pair of bonded allies who use their legendary coordination when engaged in high-speed skirmishes. Few starships have survived this deadly combination.

specialAbilities.name: Hoist Petard
specialAbilities.trigger: The Vigilance is targeted by missiles or torpedoes
specialAbilities.requirements: There’s another target within range of the Vigilance’s Speed and the triggering attack’s range
specialAbilities.effect: The Vigilance Boosts Thrusters and selects one other starship in a zone it passes through to become the new target of the attack, as long as that starship is also within range of the triggering effect. This can include the starship that made the triggering effect.

name: Opulus Drift Cruiser
description: Verces has a long history of space exploration stretching back to the ancient dirigible-like vessels known as aetherships. Modern aetherships are designed for recreation, exported to the elite, or commissioned as luxury cruise ships. Decked out with antique brass fittings and hand-upholstered furniture, these ostentatious vessels still boast incredible specs that often outperform more utilitarian starships. Drift Cruisers come equipped with an emergency reorientation system, ensuring the comfort of its passengers and any valuable artwork displayed aboard.

specialAbilities.name: Emergency Reorientation
specialAbilities.trigger: The Opulus Drift Cruiser would become off-kilter
specialAbilities.effect: The Opulus Drift Cruiser automatically rights itself, losing the off-kilter condition.

specialAbilities.name: Micrometeor Cloud
specialAbilities.effect: The nearest zone to the Opulus Drift Cruiser affected by the flak thrower’s Area Fire becomes filled with flak for 1 round. The flak deals 5d4 piercing damage to Medium or smaller starships that move through that zone (DC 29 basic Reflex save). A starship that ends its movement in the zone or starts its movement in the zone is unaffected.

specialAbilities.name: System Shock
specialAbilities.effect: A starship that takes damage from the Opulus Drift Cruiser’s EMP cannon must succeed at a DC 29 Fortitude save or its generator battle station becomes malfunctioning (DC 29 to Repair Station). On a critical hit, Repairing the Station requires a DC 31 Computers or Crafting check.

name: Skyshatter Jolly Roger
description: The Jolly Roger is a highly nimble starship equipped with a rich and straightforward toolkit. It wields the reputation of its partner-in-crime, the Starsplitter, like a sharp blade that cuts into its enemies’ morale. This all-rounder model is a one-of-a-kind flag-bearer for the Starsplitter, and neither of these heart sinking and terrifying starships are seen without the other.

specialAbilities.name: Engage Lateral Thrusters
specialAbilities.effect: Jolly Roger moves up to its Speed in any direction, regardless of its heading.

specialAbilities.name: Terrifying Holo-Roger
specialAbilities.effect: Jolly Roger forcibly opens a one-way channel to a tech starship within sensor range, bringing up the renowned icon of its crew on the target’s screens, then attempts to Demoralize each enemy creature on board the target starship.

name: BMC Devastator
description: The Devastator proves the Blood Mountain Clan leaders aren’t living in the past. Equipped with cutting-edge sensors and scanners, the BMC Devastator is designed to pinpoint a vulnerable enemy zone and blast it with firepower, then track down hidden survivors and eliminate them quickly. This model cradles a hangar bay that holds up to 16 BMC Maulers or other small fighter craft.

specialAbilities.name: On Your Six
specialAbilities.trigger: A BMC Devastator would take damage
specialAbilities.effect: A small allied starship flies in and out to intercept the incoming damage. The BMC Devastator has resistance 10 to the triggering attack.

specialAbilities.name: Deploy Maulers
specialAbilities.effect: The BMC Devastator deploys up to two BMC Maulers (page 234) with the summoned and minion traits in its zone. It can have only two BMC Maulers summoned at a time. It can Command both Maulers as a single action that’s a scanners station action.

specialAbilities.name: Heavy Laser Cannon
specialAbilities.effect: The BMC Devastator fires a concentrated laser beam at a target within sensor range. The starship takes 7d6 fire damage with a DC 33 basic Reflex save.

specialAbilities.name: Sensor Sweep
specialAbilities.effect: The BMC Devastator scans a zone in sensor range. Invisible starships in the zone become concealed instead. Concealed starships in the zone are no longer concealed. Starships in the affected zone must attempt a DC 33 Fortitude save. On a failure, the BMC Devastator’s scanners tag the target, making it off-guard to the Devastator and all its allies in sensor range for 1 round. The Devastator can Sustain this effect.

name: Dominion Seeder
description: Even for those unfamiliar with the Dominion’s threat, the sight of a Seeder in the sky is instinctually terrifying. These ominous ships are tied together with strange membranes and webs of nerve-like cables, pulsating faintly as viscous fluids flow to and from the shipmind that lies at their hearts. Though these ships’ purpose is to land on vibrant planets, assimilate living organisms, and seize their brains, the shipmind who controls them must be cautious; if it stays planetside for too long, the Seeder begins to decay in the rich air, the vessel rotting around it until it can no longer escape.

attacks.name: plasma cannon
attacks.damage: 3d8+8 fire plus 1d8 electricity and thought disruption

specialAbilities.name: Shipmind’s Control
specialAbilities.effect: Thanks to its shipmind taking full control of its functions, a Dominion Seeder can react far more freely than most starships. It is permanently quickened and can use the extra action only to Change Heading. In addition, it isn’t off-guard to attacks made from the opposite direction as its heading.

specialAbilities.name: Pseudopod
specialAbilities.effect: The Dominion Seeder extends a grotesque pseudopod, tossing its foes aside. It attempts an Athletics check against the Reflex DC of a starship within 1 zone; on a success, it switches the target’s heading.

specialAbilities.name: Telekinetic Crush
specialAbilities.effect: The Dominion Seeder telekinetically slams asteroids and space debris into a zone within sensor range. Starships in the targeted zone take 14d6 bludgeoning damage (DC 33 basic Reflex save).

specialAbilities.name: Thought Disruption
specialAbilities.effect: When the Dominion Seeder hits with its plasma cannon, the target must succeed at a DC 33 Will save or one of its battle stations of the Dominion Seeder’s choice becomes malfunctioning. If the battle station is helmed, the creature helming it takes 3d8 mental damage and becomes stupefied 1 for round.

name: Sihedron Apostle
description: Many starships spying for the likes of the Pact Worlds and the Veskarium in Azlanti space suddenly lost contact with their home worlds since Ishmerai Ophir’s takeover. Only recently was the starship responsible for vanishing them revealed to the rest of the known galaxy when a Veskarium scout narrowly escaped a Sihedron Apostle patrolling near Kehtaria.

specialAbilities.name: Sihedron Cloak
specialAbilities.effect: The Sihedron Apostle is invisible to all non-Azlanti starships’ sensors. A creature helming a starship’s magic conduit can attempt to counteract the Sihedron cloak’s invisibility (7th rank; DC 34).

specialAbilities.name: Silence Sigil
specialAbilities.effect: Starships within sensor range of the Sihedron Apostle must attempt a DC 32 Will save. On a failure, all magical and technological communications on board the starship cease to function. Comm units can’t send or receive data, and starships can’t Hack Comms. Crew members helming battle stations in different rooms can’t use normal ship communications. Telepathy and other communicative spells cease functioning. Creatures with innate telepathy from their ancestry or class features are temporarily blocked from psychic communication, receiving and emitting only vague emotional impressions from other creatures while in range of the silence sigil. A creature helming a starship’s magic conduit can attempt to counteract the silence sigil with an action that’s a magic conduit station action (7th rank; DC 34).

specialAbilities.name: Kurshudi’s Aim
specialAbilities.effect: The Sihedron Apostle targets a starship within sensor range that it’s concealed from, choosing one of the ship’s battle stations to fire on. The target starship takes 3d8 electricity damage with a DC 31 basic Fortitude save. If the battle station is being helmed, the creature helming it can attempt the Fortitude save instead. Regardless of who makes the save, only the starship takes the damage and the battle station becomes malfunctioning as normal on a failure.

name: ATech Gold Bazaar
description: The ATech Gold Bazaar is a starship the size of a small city that doubles as a temple to Abadar. As its name suggests, the Gold Bazaar periodically welcomes guests to shop from its vast catalog. It also houses a number of facilities, including factories, corporate offices, and housing for employees, allowing AbadarCorp to conduct business throughout the galaxy at a moment’s notice aboard this Drift-capable mega-factory.

specialAbilities.name: Charity Lance
specialAbilities.effect: The central spire of the Gold Bazaar fires a shimmering beam in a 6-zone line. Enemies in the area take 8d8 fire damage (DC 34 basic Will save). A starship that fails this save takes a –1-zone status penalty to its Speed for 1 round as spectral molten gold clings to its hull. Profligate Prophecy is immediately recharged.

specialAbilities.name: Contractual Obligations
specialAbilities.effect: The Gold Bazaar opens a one-way line of communication between one of its negotiators and a starship within sensor range. The Gold Bazaar attempts to Demoralize a creature helming a battle station on the target starship. On a success or critical success, the target must also choose one of the following.

specialAbilities.name: Non-Compete
specialAbilities.effect: The Gold Bazaar gains resistance 10 to damage from the target starship as long as the target is frightened.

specialAbilities.name: Non-Disclosure
specialAbilities.effect: The target’s frightened value doesn’t decrease at the end of their next turn.

specialAbilities.name: Money is Time
specialAbilities.effect: The Gold Bazaar’s executive approves overtime pay for all employees on the starship. The Gold Bazaar is quickened for 1 minute and can use the additional action only to Boost Thrusters or Change Heading.

specialAbilities.name: Profligate Prophecy
specialAbilities.frequency: once per day and recharges when the Gold Bazaar uses Charity Lance
specialAbilities.effect: The Gold Bazaar’s pious residents trade a portion of the day’s profits for assistance from Abadar. The first time the Gold Bazaar succeeds at an attack roll this turn, that attack becomes a critical success.

name: Alghollthu Warshell
description: The alghollthus, aquatic occultists who live in the depths of space vying for power, believe physical combat is beneath them. Accordingly, they remotely pilot great shells, purposefully bred to fit their controller’s needs so that it can be manipulated via the alghollthu’s swarm of quantum nanites. Warshells are the variety most commonly seen by others, designed to infiltrate and destroy the encroaching fleets of sentient cultures. Though they pale in comparison to the legendary Slayershells—those designed to hunt and kill divine beings—they’re still more than dangerous enough to dismantle a crew of mere mortals.

specialAbilities.name: Living Starship
specialAbilities.effect: The starship is a living organism or composed entirely of biomass. A living starship usually has organs or structures instead of battle stations. Living starships don’t have starship immunities.

specialAbilities.name: Nanite Scrying
specialAbilities.effect: 2 zones. The Warshell constantly disperses its controller’s nanites, spreading their influence. It ignores the concealed and hidden conditions of starships within the area, and it always knows the exact positions of the crew and any other creatures within those starships.

specialAbilities.name: Mindwarp Field
specialAbilities.effect: The Warshell projects a dissonant cosmic field through its nanites, distorting space around it. For 1 minute, it becomes concealed to all starships that are more than 2 zones away.

specialAbilities.name: Psychic Mutiny
specialAbilities.effect: The Warshell injects nanites into a starship within its nanite scrying aura, attempting to seize control of a crew member. One creature of the Warshell’s choice aboard the starship must attempt a DC 34 Will save and then becomes immune to Psychic Mutiny for 24 hours.

outcomes.success: The creature is controlled by the Warshell for its first action on its next turn.
outcomes.failure: The creature is controlled by the Warshell for 1 minute. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns, and the effect ends immediately if the Warshell uses Psychic Mutiny against a different target.
outcomes.criticalFailure: As failure, but the creature can’t attempt a new save at the end of its turns.

name: Inheritorworks Cathedralship
description: The pride and joy of any Inheritorworks foundry, these colossal capital ships are each constructed as one-of-a-kind flying temples to lead a newly commissioned fleet of Knights. Equipped with tremendously powerful magic conduits, a Cathedralship can distribute blessings across entire zones of space, empowering an entire fleet at once. Even on its own, a Cathedralship is an imposing threat. The entire temple acts as a massive superweapon, concentrating divine power into a devastating blast.

specialAbilities.name: Blessing Beacon
specialAbilities.effect: The Cathedralship ignites a burning beacon of divine power, invigorating its crew and allies. The Cathedralship and allies within 1 zone gain a +1 status bonus to attack rolls and AC until the end of its next turn. The effect can be Sustained up to 1 minute.

specialAbilities.name: Echoes of Golarion
specialAbilities.effect: The cathedral conjures echoes of ancient heroes from Golarion on a starship within its sensor range. Each creature helming a battle station on the target starship takes 4d12 spirit damage (DC 34 basic Reflex save); enemies with starship immunities aren’t immune to this damage.

specialAbilities.name: Spiritual Armory
specialAbilities.effect: The Cathedralship conjures countless ghostly echoes of its heavy cannon, unleashing a deadly broadside. It makes four heavy cannon Strikes at its current multiple attack penalty, each with a –5 circumstance penalty to the attack roll.

specialAbilities.name: Ultimate Divine Lance
specialAbilities.effect: Each spire on the Cathedralship illuminates in turn before releasing a colossal blast of holy light in a 2-zone burst within sensor range. Enemies in the area take 15d6 spirit damage (DC 34 basic Will save); enemies with starship immunities aren’t immune to this damage.

name: Skyshatter Starsplitter
description: Starsplitter is a starship feared across several systems, always accompanied by its Jolly Roger. With its elite crew, remotely controlled spearhead drones, and deadly rail cannon—modified to concentrate power on singular shots— Starsplitter has proven itself to be one of the most dangerous starships across the galaxy.

specialAbilities.name: Deploy Spearhead Drone
specialAbilities.effect: Starsplitter deploys a drone in its zone. The drone is a tiny starship object with AC 28, 20 HP, Hardness 10, and object immunities. Starsplitter can have only two drones deployed at once, and if it would deploy a third, one of its previously deployed drones is destroyed.

specialAbilities.name: Impale
specialAbilities.effect: Starsplitter directs a deployed spearhead drone within sensor range to impale a starship within 0 zones of the drone. The target takes 3d12+22 piercing damage (DC 34 basic Reflex save). The drone is destroyed. If this damages the target’s Hull Points, Starsplitter chooses a battle station on the target to become malfunctioning.

specialAbilities.name: Jailbroken Jamming Algorithm
specialAbilities.effect: Starsplitter scans for targets in a zone within sensor range. Tech starships in the targeted zone must succeed at a DC 34 Will save or be hacked for 1 round, taking a –1 status penalty to their AC and a –1-zone status penalty to their Speed and sensor range.

specialAbilities.name: Phalanx Formation
specialAbilities.effect: Each deployed spearhead drone within sensor range moves up to 2 zones.

specialAbilities.name: Wave Holo-Roger
specialAbilities.effect: A Free Captain starship’s holo-roger is a sight that gives rise to courage in the hearts of its allies. Allied creatures and starships within sensor range of the starship gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Will saves against fear effects for 1 round.

name: Biotech Sporehall
description: Forever changed by an ancient encounter with an all- consuming fungus, biotech giants are nomads and skilled scientists who incorporate the mysterious mycelium into their bodies and technology while they search for a new home. Their great Sporehalls act as mobile settlements and labs, carrying giant researchers between numerous ecosystems and defending them from the dangers of the Vast with powerful fungal weapons.

specialAbilities.name: Mycelial Infection
specialAbilities.effect: When the Biotech Sporehall deals damage to a starship’s Hull Points with its heavy spore cannon, the spores latch onto the target’s hull and stretch inside. The affected starship must attempt a DC 36 Fortitude save; on a failure, one of its battle stations of the Biotech Sporehall’s choice becomes malfunctioning. If the battle station is helmed, the creature helming it takes 8d6 poison damage (DC 36 basic Fortitude save).

specialAbilities.name: Agitate Mycelium
specialAbilities.requirements: A starship within sensor range has a battle station that’s malfunctioning due to mycelial infection
specialAbilities.effect: The mycelium begins to spread through that starship. The Biotech Sporehall uses mycelial infection on the required starship even though the Biotech Sporehall hasn’t dealt additional damage to its Hull Points.

specialAbilities.name: Spread Mycelium
specialAbilities.effect: The Biotech Sporehall extends countless microscopic-charged tendrils in a 0-zone emanation, damaging any who approach. Enemies that enter or start their turn in the area take 8d6 electricity damage (DC 36 basic Fortitude save). On subsequent turns, the Biotech Sporehall can Sustain the effect once per turn to increase the size of the emanation by 1 zone, and the effect lasts until the Biotech Sporehall leaves its current zone.

name: Infernex Citadel
description: Citadels are the capital battleships of the Hellknight fleet, capable of subjugating entire settlements with their mere presence. No two Infernex Citadels are quite the same, as each is tailor-made for a specific order and purpose, often with weapons and equipment customized to its commanding lictor’s exact specifications. Infernex Citadels are battle stations that act as the central headquarters for an entire Hellknight Order, capable of docking countless smaller ships. A Citadel’s arrival is enough to put a planetary government on high alert and cause chaos in the streets, a panic rarely sated by the Hellknights’ insistence that their continued presence is necessary to restore the law and order they disrupted by being there.

specialAbilities.name: Decree of Guilt
specialAbilities.effect: The Infernex Citadel’s commanding Hellknight attempts a single Intimidation check to Demoralize all crew members of a starship in sensor range. A crew member can’t reduce its frightened condition below 1 while its ship is affected by the Citadel’s Tractor Beam.

specialAbilities.name: Kindling of Order
specialAbilities.effect: The Citadel’s hull ignites into infernal flames. Each non-allied starship within 0 zones takes 17d6 fire damage (DC basic 34 Reflex save). The Citadel regains Hull Points equal to half the damage dice it rolls. The Citadel can’t use Kindling of Order for 1d4 rounds.

specialAbilities.name: Sensor Sweep
specialAbilities.effect: The Infernex Citadel scans a zone in sensor range. Invisible starships in the zone become concealed instead. Concealed starships in the zone are no longer concealed. Starships in the affected zone must attempt a DC 37 Fortitude save. On a failure, the Citadel’s scanners tag the target, making it off-guard to the Citadel and all its allies in sensor range for 1 round. The Citadel can Sustain this effect.

specialAbilities.name: Tractor Beam
specialAbilities.effect: A target within 2 zones must attempt a Fortitude save.

outcomes.success: The target takes a –1-zone status penalty to its Speed for 1 round.
outcomes.failure: The target is pulled 1 zone closer to the starship, and it takes a –1-zone status penalty to its Speed for 1 round.
outcomes.criticalFailure: The target is pulled 2 zones closer to the starship, and it takes a –2-zone status penalty to its Speed for 1 round.

name: Klokworx Nexus
description: Klokworx Industries has always bent the empire’s rules. The first Klokworx robots were built for tasks deemed too dangerous for a descendant of Azlant. First-generation models labored alongside non-human residents of the Star Empire. Klokworx engineers didn’t program Azlanti cultural bigotry into the robots’ code, so the helpful machines soon found a new core objective in improving jobsite conditions for their non-human coworkers. The engineer’s overuse of automation created a code loophole that gave the machines free will. The upgraded Klokworx bots became sentient robotic organisms with their own beliefs, feelings, and thoughts. Facing the ugly truth of the evil empire they served, the bots fought back the only way they knew how. First, they secretly took over the company. Then they recruited disguised androids to fool imperial inspectors into thinking Azlanti still run the company. They hired and trained as many non-humans as they could. Klokworx staff are treated fairly by their machine bosses and work in relative safety—when a job’s too risky, they call in a robot. Klokworx funds their imperfect utopia by selling to anyone with credits. The empire is still their top customer, and they’ve continued manufacturing cutting-edge vessels for exiled royalist forces while simultaneously arming Ishmerai’s Sihedron Guard with the same munitions. The Nexus even has a few loyal customers within the Veskarium military. The newly redesigned Nexus has played a pivotal role in both Ishmerai’s coup against the Aeon Throne and his campaign against the Veskarium. It was developed in secret under his direction in preparation for the day he would usurp the throne. It’s a powerful carrier that can go toe to toe with the flagships of other factions, and despite its enormous size and power, Klokworx has been able to produce numerous Nexus starships for the Sihedron Guard.

attacks.name: laser
attacks.damage: 3d6+14 fire (originates from a deployed drone within sensor range)

specialAbilities.name: Deploy Drone
specialAbilities.effect: The Klokworx Nexus deploys a magical drone in its zone. The drone is a small starship object with AC 30, 25 HP, Hardness 10, and object immunities. The Klokworx Nexus can only have four deployed drones at a time. If it would deploy a fifth, one of its previously deployed drones is destroyed.

specialAbilities.name: Laser Barrage
specialAbilities.effect: The Klokworx Nexus’s numerous light laser cannons unleash a fusillade of fire. All starships in a 2-zone-cone take 8d6 fire damage (DC 35 basic Reflex save).

specialAbilities.name: Nexus Formation
specialAbilities.effect: Each deployed drone within sensor range moves up to 2 zones.

specialAbilities.name: Nexus Swarm
specialAbilities.effect: Each drone within the Klokworx Nexus’s sensor range fires at a target in its zone. Each affected starship takes 3d8+16 fire damage with a DC 33 basic Reflex save. If a starship is targeted by multiple drones, it rolls its save and takes damage only once, but it rolls its save with a –1 circumstance penalty.

specialAbilities.name: Ultimate Shock Cannon
specialAbilities.effect: The klokworx Nexus fires a massive beam of crackling energy in a 6-zone-line in the direction of its heading. Affected targets take 20d8 electricity damage with a DC 35 basic Fortitude save.

name: Hivebound Behemoth
description: A Hivebound Behemoth isn’t equipped to board or overtake opposing starships; its only purpose is to annihilate anything that stands in the way of the Swarm. Its enormous gnashing maw tears massive chunks out of even the most heavily armored foes, while its psychic howls terrify their crew, warping space itself with their fear.

specialAbilities.name: Living Starship
specialAbilities.effect: The starship is a living organism or composed entirely of biomass. A living starship usually has organs or structures instead of battle stations. Living starships don’t have starship immunities.

specialAbilities.name: Engaged Strike
specialAbilities.effect: This starship attempts a devouring maw Strike against the triggering starship.
specialAbilities.trigger: A starship in the same zone moves to another zone

specialAbilities.name: Bilgebiters
specialAbilities.effect: When the Behemoth hits and deals damage to a starship with its devouring maw, it injects millions of tiny components into the targeted starship. A szynegator swarm (Starfinder Alien Core 183) appears in a space of the Behemoth’s choice inside the targeted starship, taking its turn immediately after the Behemoth. Battle stations within the szynegator swarm’s comm occlusion aura are malfunctioning as long as they’re in the aura.

specialAbilities.name: Psychic Scream
specialAbilities.effect: The Behemoth howls through its colony mind. Each crew member of a non-kucharn starship in a 1-zone emanation must succeed at a DC 38 Will save or become frightened 2. The zone the Behemoth is in is filled with lingering psychic energy that lasts for 1 round; creatures on starships within the same zone as the Behemoth don’t reduce their frightened condition at the end of their turn, and starships that start their turn in the zone must succeed at a DC 38 Will save or be stunned 1.

specialAbilities.name: Thrashing Charge
specialAbilities.effect: The Behemoth rushes recklessly at its prey, Boosting Thrusters then making a melee Strike. It becomes off-guard until the start of its next turn.

name: Barrow Cenotaph
description: The Barrow Cenotaph is the Corpse Fleet’s flagship. This resilient, lumbering mass of necrotech is always surrounded by countless dutybound vessels that are ready to shield it with their unlives.

specialAbilities.name: Command Dutybound
specialAbilities.trigger: The Barrow Cenotaph would take damage from an attack
specialAbilities.effect: The Barrow Cenotaph gains resistance 16 to the triggering damage.

specialAbilities.name: Crush Obstacle
specialAbilities.effect: The Barrow Cenotaph Boosts Thrusters, and if it moves at least 1 zone, it can select an enemy starship within 0 zones at any point along its movement. The target takes 9d12 bludgeoning damage (DC 40 basic Fortitude save). On a failure, the target is off-kilter.

specialAbilities.name: Death Accumulation Cannon
specialAbilities.effect: The Barrow Cenotaph fires an 11-zone line beam in the direction of its heading. Affected starships take 6d12 force damage (DC 38 basic Reflex save).

specialAbilities.name: Kill Battle Station
specialAbilities.effect: The Barrow Cenotaph deploys cyberattacks at a starship within sensor range. The target starship takes 3d12+18 force damage (DC 38 basic Will save). On a failure, the Barrow Cenotaph chooses a battle station on the target starship to become malfunctioning.

name: Vindicas Tyrant
description: The Vindicas Tyrant is a mobile bastion, armed to the teeth and crammed full of elite troops. Intelligence from listening posts on Pulonis and Vesk-3 has revealed the presence of eight Vindicas Tyrants. At least three remain behind to defend the home system. Three others have been sighted on the front lines of the clash for Conqueror’s Path. The last two’s whereabouts are unknown.

specialAbilities.name: Heavy Torpedo Launcher
specialAbilities.effect: The Vindicas Tyrant launches heavy torpedoes at a target in sensor range, dealing 10d8 fire and 10d8 piercing damage to all starships in the target’s zone with a DC 42 basic Reflex save.

specialAbilities.name: Merciless Aim
specialAbilities.effect: The BMC Mauler locks onto a starship in sensor range. While locked-on, the target takes a –1 status penalty to its AC and Reflex saves against the BMC Mauler until the end of the BMC Mauler’s next turn or until it’s targeted by an attack from one of the BMC Mauler’s gunneries, whichever happens first.

specialAbilities.name: Will of Damoritosh
specialAbilities.effect: The Conqueror lends his might to loyal soldiers of the Veskarium. A Vindicas Tyrant and its allies within sensor range each deal an additional 1d10 piercing damage with their attacks for 1 minute. Affected starships also ignore penalties to Speed and forced movement effects.
